payload.title: Count platform calls before publishing (#26)
payload.objective: Publishing counts its own calls per channel, so a daily platform limit is seen coming and not hit unnoticed.
successCriteria: Publishing counts calls in the window insights polling uses and keeps priority over polling
Approving or scheduling a post that cannot fit says so before it is due
A post held back by the limit goes out when the window allows, without a duplicate
The count is shared when one account is connected in several workspaces
